name: The Traitors
description: The entertainment industry’s most competitive reality stars and famous faces play the ultimate murder mystery game. Hosted by award-winning actor Alan Cumming at an ancient castle set deep in the Scottish Highlands, contestants work together on a series of exhilarating missions to build a prize fund worth up to $250,000. Hidden amongst the Faithful are the Traitors, whose goal is to eliminate the Faithful and claim the prize for themselves.

videos.title: The Game Is Afoot
videos.overview: Twenty contestants arrive at a castle in Scotland to play the ultimate murder mystery game.

videos.title: Buried Alive
videos.overview: The first murder raises suspicions as the contestants are buried alive; a player is banished.

videos.title: Murder They Wrote
videos.overview: The next murder shocks everyone; while a player is banished, another makes a dramatic discovery.

videos.title: Life or Death Situation
videos.overview: Cracks start to show in the treacherous trio as the game's pressure begins to weigh on one of them.

videos.title: Getting Away with Murder
videos.overview: A Traitor raises suspicions; a mission gives players a chance to raise the prize pot over $100,000.

videos.title: Suspicion and Sabotage
videos.overview: The game has a new lifeline, but for three players, being On Trial puts them closer to murder.

videos.title: The Mask Is Slipping
videos.overview: A Traitor's mask begins to slip; ghosts of former players return; a plot twist unfolds.

videos.title: Cabins in the Woods
videos.overview: One player must make the ultimate decision; a Traitor raises suspicion; a brutal roundtable ensues.

videos.title: Trust No One
videos.overview: During the penultimate day, alliances are broken and trust between the Traitors is questioned.

videos.title: The Grand Finale
videos.overview: After a last mission and roundtable, either the Traitors or Faithful will win the prize pot.

videos.title: The Reunion
videos.overview: The cast of “The Traitors” settles the score on all the lies, murders, banishments and treachery.

videos.title: Betrayers, Fakes and Fraudsters
videos.overview: An all-star cast arrives in Scotland; the Traitors are chosen, but there's a twist this time around.

videos.title: Welcome to the Dark Side
videos.overview: The Traitors want a newcomer; a mission reveals hard truths; the first murder and banishment occur.

videos.title: Murder in Plain Sight

videos.title: The Funeral
videos.overview: The Traitors' next murder is done in plain sight; one player must take their last breath.

videos.title: A Killer Move
videos.overview: The castle welcomes a new arrival; the Faithful fight back; one of the Traitors is in the hot seat.

videos.title: Backstab and Betrayal
videos.overview: The Traitors start to turn on each other and face a difficult dilemma that could backfire.

videos.title: Blood on Their Hands
videos.overview: The Traitors discover whether their seduction was successful; Alan has a deadly surprise.

videos.title: Knives at Dawn
videos.overview: The Traitors find their backs against the wall; a special guest appears during a beastly mission.

videos.title: A Game of Death
videos.overview: A Faithful and a Traitor clash; a Faithful must decide their fate after being given an ultimatum.

videos.title: The Weight of Deceit
videos.overview: The Faithful seem to be closing in as doubt spreads among one Traitor's loyal supporters.

videos.title: One Final Hurdle
videos.overview: The toughest mission yet occurs on land, air and sea, with the Faithful or Traitors winning it all.

videos.title: Reunion (Uncensored)
videos.overview: The cast of “The Traitors” airs their grievances regarding murders, banishments and treachery.

videos.title: Let Battle Commence
videos.overview: A new all-star cast arrives in Scotland; before the Traitors are chosen, a decision must be made.

videos.title: Revenge Is a Dish Best Served Cold
videos.overview: Three new players enter the game; the Traitors draw their first blood, and a player is banished.

videos.title: Nail in a Coffin
videos.overview: The Traitors must meet outside of their tower to commit their next murder in plain sight.

videos.title: I Will Bury You Under the Sand
videos.overview: A dramatic murder casts suspicion on two Faithfuls; a Traitor must stay out of the spotlight.

videos.title: A Dysfunctional Family
videos.overview: With tensions high, the Traitors must still work together; two dangerous Faithfuls hatch a plan.

videos.title: Til Death Us Do Part
videos.overview: The Traitors must murder face-to-face in the most dramatic send-off the castle has ever seen.

videos.title: A B*tch Is Lying
videos.overview: The Faithful seek to close the lid on the coffin theory; an alliance of gamers sparks suspicion.

videos.title: The Power of the Seer
videos.overview: One Faithful faces a big decision; the mission offers the players a chance to win a great power.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: The cast of "The Traitors" air their grievances regarding murders, banishments and treachery.

videos.title: The Death Conga

videos.title: Show Me Your Faces

videos.title: Cut the Head Off the Snake
videos.overview: A fiery mission results in several players up for murder; there's a big swing at the roundtable.

videos.title: If You're Gonna Come for Me, I'll Finish You
videos.overview: The mission offers the chance to stop the night's murder, but only if the Faithful stick together.

videos.title: Planning a Coup
videos.overview: The Faithful plan a coup and one Traitor is accused to their face; the roundtable brings difficult decisions; with the temperature in the turret at its boiling point, the Traitors must pull off the bloodiest murder the castle has ever seen.

videos.title: The Black Banquet
videos.overview: A bloody banquet shakes the whole castle; Traitor trust teeters; the mission means a trek to the epic Fyrish Monument, where one player wins a great power; alliances are tested at the roundtable.

videos.title: A Queen Never Comes Off Her Throne
videos.overview: While the temperature rises between the Traitors, a strategic murder shakes the castle; alliances are tested and a heated conversation makes for a simmering roundtable; one player has an impossible decision to make.

videos.title: Think Outside the Box
videos.overview: While a new alliance is tested, suspicions force an old one into the spotlight; the mission puts the Traitors under pressure and one player receives some unwanted attention; the creepiest murder yet is about to be sprung on one of the Faithful.

videos.title: Do You Know the Enemy?
videos.overview: With a place in the final at stake, emotions run high as friendships are tested to their limits.

videos.title: Leap of Faith
videos.overview: Doubt and paranoia run through the castle as attempts are made to sway players' allegiances.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: Host Andy Cohen talks with the Season 4 cast of "The Traitors" about their time in the castle.

awards: Won 8 Primetime Emmys. 17 wins & 27 nominations total
